summary.text: Craig Snow is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 22, has served in the Indiana House since 2020, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is a business executive from Warsaw, Indiana.

paragraphs.text: Craig Snow lives in Warsaw, Indiana, graduated from Warsaw Community High School, and earned a B.S. in business administration from Grace College.
His career experience includes working as CEO of Cedar Holdings and as board chair of Silveus Insurance Group, and he has served with the Global Leadership Summit.
Snow won election to the Indiana House in 2020, originally in District 18, and has represented District 22 since November 9, 2022.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026, and is the only candidate listed for District 22 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the Insurance and Ways and Means committees, serving as vice chair of Ways and Means.
